result.instructions: Tools for Storecove, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Can Acme's Dutch company receive e-invoices on Peppol?"; "Send this UBL invoice to the customer's Peppol address and show me the delivery evidence."; "What do we know about legal entity 1234 and its administrations?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Storecove data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run storecove_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run storecove_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run storecove_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. storecove_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: storecove_discover_participant
tools.title: Discover a Peppol participant
tools.description: Check whether a company can receive e-invoices on the Peppol network, and which document types it accepts. Use the scheme and identifier of the company, for example its VAT or company number. Storecove API: POST /discovery/receives.

scheme.description: The identifier scheme, as listed in Storecove's receiver identifiers list (for example a country VAT scheme).

document_types.description: Document types to check for. Default: invoice and creditnote.

tools.name: storecove_get_legal_entity
tools.title: Get a legal entity
tools.description: Get one legal entity (a company that sends documents), with its Peppol identifiers and settings. Storecove API: GET /legal_entities/{id}.

legal_entity_id.description: The legal entity id (from your Storecove account).

tools.name: storecove_get_administration
tools.title: Get an administration
tools.description: Get one administration (an accounting administration under a legal entity), for example the email that receives documents. Storecove API: GET /legal_entities/{legal_entity_id}/administrations/{id}.

legal_entity_id.description: The legal entity id (from your Storecove account).

tools.name: storecove_get_document_submission_evidence
tools.title: Get document submission evidence
tools.description: Get the delivery status and evidence of a submitted document, by its submission guid. Use 'sending' for delivery evidence or 'clearing' for clearing evidence. Storecove API: GET /document_submissions/{guid}/evidence/{evidence_type}.

guid.description: The document submission guid, returned by storecove_submit_document.

tools.name: storecove_get_purchase_invoice
tools.title: Get a received purchase invoice
tools.description: Get one received purchase invoice in JSON form, by its guid (the purchase_invoice guid from a webhook). Storecove API: GET /purchase_invoices/{guid}.

tools.name: storecove_submit_document
tools.title: Send an invoice
tools.description: SENDS a real e-invoice to the recipient over Peppol (or by email, if you give fallback emails). Give the sender legal_entity_id and a base64 UBL or CII invoice file; Storecove parses it and routes it. Sending cannot be undone. Use only after the user confirms the recipient and the invoice. Storecove API: POST /document_submissions.

legal_entity_id.description: The sending legal entity id. Give this or receive_guid.

receive_guid.description: The guid of a received document, for response documents only. Give this or legal_entity_id.

invoice_base64.description: The invoice file, base64 encoded. A UBL or CII XML invoice.

parse_strategy.description: The XML syntax of the invoice file.

recipient_scheme.description: Recipient identifier scheme, if routing by identifier.

recipient_identifier.description: Recipient identifier value, if routing by identifier.

fallback_emails.description: Email addresses to use when the recipient is not on Peppol.

idempotency_guid.description: A GUID you make for this send. A repeat with the same GUID is rejected, so a retry cannot send twice.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Storecove
prompts.description: What you can do with Storecove here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: check_whether_a_company_can_receive_peppol_e_invoices
prompts.title: Check whether a company can receive Peppol e-invoices
prompts.description: Look up the company by its VAT or company number. See whether it can receive e-invoices and which document types it accepts.

prompts.name: look_up_a_sending_company_and_its_administrations
prompts.title: Look up a sending company and its administrations
prompts.description: Open a legal entity by its ID to see its Peppol identifiers and settings. Then open one of its administrations, such as the one that receives documents.

prompts.name: track_the_delivery_of_a_sent_invoice
prompts.title: Track the delivery of a sent invoice
prompts.description: Read the sending or clearing evidence of a submitted document by its guid. Check it to confirm the delivery status.

prompts.name: read_a_received_purchase_invoice
prompts.title: Read a received purchase invoice
prompts.description: Open a received purchase invoice in JSON form by its guid, such as the guid from a webhook. Review its fields.

prompts.name: send_an_invoice_to_a_peppol_recipient
prompts.title: Send an invoice to a Peppol recipient
prompts.description: After the user confirms the recipient and the invoice, send a UBL or CII file over Peppol. Then read the delivery evidence. Sending cannot be undone.
